item.title: Hunting: well-placed to achieve strong, long-term growth, with Order Book extending, this week’s Interims will show the way
item.summary: Next Friday, 21st August, the precision engineering group Hunting (LON:HTG) will announce its Interim Results for the six months to end-June. They should show a good set of figures, with the £709m-capitalised group reiterating its confidence for the full-year’s results. The group’s shares have risen from 246p in March last year, to over 553p in early March this year.
